name: machine-health
description: Tells you and Claude, at session start, what is slowing the machine: orphaned agent and test processes, sustained memory pressure and swap growth, low disk, a runaway fseventsd. Each finding comes with one suggested step that Claude offers and runs only on your yes; the plugin itself executes nothing. Ships a status-line command your own status-line script can call. macOS first; Linux and Windows builds are silent until measured.
